description:
Do Woojin, a bassist in an indie band, was an oddball with a strangely gloomy aura—and an almost absurd amount of bad luck.
After his previous bands disbanded one after another, leaving him with nowhere to go, a third chance finally came his way.
It was in this new band that he met Choi Heesoo…
For Heesoo, who had lived an ordinary life—his biggest act of rebellion being the pentagram tattoo on his forearm—Woojin, whose thoughts were impossible to read, felt nothing but awkward.
During a post-practice drinking session, while the band members chatted boisterously, Woojin answered half-heartedly with an uncomfortable expression—until his gaze landed on Heesoo’s tattoo.
“…A pentagram symbolizes the devil.”
For the first time, a spark of interest flickered in Woojin’s otherwise empty eyes.
But wait, what had their bandmate said while introducing Woojin earlier?
"I warned you, didn’t I? That guy’s a total nutcase."

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
